# Daltile Products

[[Library study area with light and dark green floor tile, blue wall tile, floor-to-ceiling windows,
desks with computers and rolling chairs, and white sectional sofas.]][243]

### [Tile][244]

[Ceramic tile and porcelain tile, the foundation of our tile selection, includes retro subway tile,
modern wood look tile and every style in between.][245]
[[French country kitchen with white with gray veining marble look backsplash, countertop, and island
with sink, pendant lights, and dark green lower cabinets.]][246]

### [Countertops][247]

[From stunning Natural Stone to durable ONE Quartz to award-winning Panoramic Porcelain, shop the
country's largest countertop selection.][248]
[[DAL_Dolores_Catania-0464_LV34_11web]][249]

### [Backsplash][250]

[Whether subway tile, natural stone, mixed element mosaics, or encaustic tile, our bathroom and
kitchen backsplash adds protection in grand style.][251]
[[Modern dining room with black marble look tile flooring, open fireplace with cream & brown granite
surround, table & chairs in front of glass sliding doors.]][252]

### [Natural Stone][253]

[Our broad, unrivaled selection of natural stone includes traditional tile sizes, extra-large slab,
plank, and a wide variety of mosaics.][254]
[[Dry bar with white & gray diamond-shaped backsplash, gold trimmed hi-ball glass and shaker on a
white quartz countertop.]][255]

### [Mosaics][256]

[Perfect for pools, shower floors, kitchen & bathroom backsplashes, our unmatched assortment of
eye-catching mosaics offers timeless style.][257]
[[DAL_MystoneLimestone_RES_08_2cm_11web]][258]

### [Xteriors™][259]

[All-weather products - including our strongest commercial grade tile that can withstand even
vehicle traffic - with the high-style we're known for.][260]
[Daltile Manhattan Showroom store front displaying multiple tile samples.]

## AMERICA'S LEADER

Daltile is the country's leading manufacturer and distributor of ceramic tile, porcelain tile &
natural stone. Built on a tradition of outstanding design, quality, and service, for over 75 years
we have set the standard for the tile industry. We are committed to providing trustworthy floor
tile, wall tile, and countertops, with 80 of our collections proudly made in the USA.

## SURFACE MATTERS

Cover more ground.

[ EXPLORE CARPET TILE ][171]

# COMMERCIAL FLOORING THAT'S MADE FOR MORE

Discover the latest Interface flooring collections for your next project.

[ [Interface Dual Effect and Thread Lightly carpet tile in open office] ][172]
Interface | Carpet Tile

### Crafted Connections

Drawing from textile traditions that endure, Crafted Connections™ combines woven textures, bouclé
tweeds and batik styles into one coordinated collection.
[VIEW COLLECTION][173]
[ [Interface Hearth plank LVT with E615 plank carpet tile in private meeting room] ][174]
Interface | LVT

### Earthen Forms

By tapping into the warmth of natural woodgrain and the cool textures of travertine stone, Earthen
Forms™ brings the great outdoors indoors.
[VIEW COLLECTION][175]
[ [norament castello ed in production cleanroom] ][176]
Interface | nora Rubber

### norament ed

Protection to stand on. And count on. norament® ed flooring discharges static quickly and reliably –
safeguarding people, electronic devices and sensitive equipment.
[VIEW PRODUCTS][177]

## MORE THAN JUST A PRETTY FACE

[Interface Broome Street carpet tile in office with birthday celebration]
[Interface E610 carpet tile with woman seated and looking out a window]

## MADE FOR MORE


It’s flooring—but way more fun, inspiring, and groundbreakingly original.

[ LEARN MORE ][178]

## MADE FOR BIG IDEAS.

## AND NAILING THE DETAILS.

 

From concept to footfall, we put our time, energy and ingenuity into every step.

Then we do it all over again.

[ LEARN MORE ][179]

### BEAUTIFUL DESIGNS.

### AND MORE.

Want to see our favourites? Spoiler alert—it’s hard to pick just one.

[ GET INSPIRED ][180]

### CALL IN THE

### EXPERTS

From initial sketch to final floor, the team at Interface Design Studio knows how to push creativity
further.

[ SEE ALL SERVICES ][181]
[Interface Floor Design Tool Mockup]

### BRING YOUR DESIGNS TO LIFE

Our Floor Design Tool lets your flooring ideas come to life—right here in your browser.

[ TRY THE TOOL ][182]

### CARBON REDUCTIONS, **not offsets**

Absolute emission reduction is critical to meet the climate crisis. Offsets are a distraction from
this goal, and we know the time is now to lead. We're backing up our words with more solutions that
accelerate carbon reduction and storage, rather than offsets.

[LEARN MORE][183]

## WEAVING SUSTAINABILITY INTO EVERYTHING WE CREATE

From recycling initiatives to the first ever carbon negative carpet tile, discover how we’re
changing the game.

### Carbon Reduction

We’re transparent about the carbon impact of your purchase to help you achieve low carbon design.
Our carbon plan is simple: Avoid. Reduce. Store. Inspire.
[Learn More][184]

### Product Transparency

We enlist outside partners to evaluate the environmental and human impacts of our flooring.
[Learn More][185]

### Recycling & Reuse

We have been actively collecting, rehoming and recycling our carpet tiles for more than 20 years.
[Learn More][186]

## EVERY GOOD DESIGN STARTS WITH A SYSTEM

Discover our full system of modular flooring, including resilient flooring products.

[ [Interface Angular Times plank carpet tile in private office] ][187]

### CARPET TILE BENEFITS

Learn how our innovative, modular carpet tile can make your space more beautiful, comfortable,
sustainable and positive.

[LEARN MORE][188]

### NORA® RUBBER BENEFITS

Produced with precision in Germany for more than 70 years, nora by Interface represents the pinnacle
of high-traffic, high-performance flooring.

[LEARN MORE][189]
[ [Interface Heirloom plank LVT in workplace seating area] ][190]

### LUXURY VINYL TILE BENEFITS

Blend hard and soft surfaces together for a custom approach to flooring that meets a diversity of
needs with our best-in-class LVT.
[LEARN MORE][191]
[ [Interface Antiquities carpet tile ] ][192]

### AREA RUGS BENEFITS

Our integrated system of carpet and LVT allow for seamless rug insets, and our carpet tile can float
freely on any hard surface.
[LEARN MORE][193]

## SURFACE MATTERS

Cover more ground.

[ EXPLORE CARPET TILE ][171]

# COMMERCIAL FLOORING THAT'S MADE FOR MORE

Discover the latest Interface flooring collections for your next project.

[ [Interface Dual Effect and Thread Lightly carpet tile in open office] ][172]
Interface | Carpet Tile

### Crafted Connections

Drawing from textile traditions that endure, Crafted Connections™ combines woven textures, bouclé
tweeds and batik styles into one coordinated collection.
[VIEW COLLECTION][173]
[ [Interface Hearth plank LVT with E615 plank carpet tile in private meeting room] ][174]
Interface | LVT

### Earthen Forms

By tapping into the warmth of natural woodgrain and the cool textures of travertine stone, Earthen
Forms™ brings the great outdoors indoors.
[VIEW COLLECTION][175]
[ [norament castello ed in production cleanroom] ][176]
Interface | nora Rubber

### norament ed

Protection to stand on. And count on. norament® ed flooring discharges static quickly and reliably –
safeguarding people, electronic devices and sensitive equipment.
[VIEW PRODUCTS][177]

## MORE THAN JUST A PRETTY FACE

[Interface Broome Street carpet tile in office with birthday celebration]
[Interface E610 carpet tile with woman seated and looking out a window]

## MADE FOR MORE


It’s flooring—but way more fun, inspiring, and groundbreakingly original.

[ LEARN MORE ][178]

## MADE FOR BIG IDEAS.

## AND NAILING THE DETAILS.

 

From concept to footfall, we put our time, energy and ingenuity into every step.

Then we do it all over again.

[ LEARN MORE ][179]

### BEAUTIFUL DESIGNS.

### AND MORE.

Want to see our favourites? Spoiler alert—it’s hard to pick just one.

[ GET INSPIRED ][180]

### CALL IN THE

### EXPERTS

From initial sketch to final floor, the team at Interface Design Studio knows how to push creativity
further.

[ SEE ALL SERVICES ][181]
[Interface Floor Design Tool Mockup]

### BRING YOUR DESIGNS TO LIFE

Our Floor Design Tool lets your flooring ideas come to life—right here in your browser.

[ TRY THE TOOL ][182]

### CARBON REDUCTIONS, **not offsets**

Absolute emission reduction is critical to meet the climate crisis. Offsets are a distraction from
this goal, and we know the time is now to lead. We're backing up our words with more solutions that
accelerate carbon reduction and storage, rather than offsets.

[LEARN MORE][183]

## WEAVING SUSTAINABILITY INTO EVERYTHING WE CREATE

From recycling initiatives to the first ever carbon negative carpet tile, discover how we’re
changing the game.

### Carbon Reduction

We’re transparent about the carbon impact of your purchase to help you achieve low carbon design.
Our carbon plan is simple: Avoid. Reduce. Store. Inspire.
[Learn More][184]

### Product Transparency

We enlist outside partners to evaluate the environmental and human impacts of our flooring.
[Learn More][185]

### Recycling & Reuse

We have been actively collecting, rehoming and recycling our carpet tiles for more than 20 years.
[Learn More][186]

## EVERY GOOD DESIGN STARTS WITH A SYSTEM

Discover our full system of modular flooring, including resilient flooring products.

[ [Interface Angular Times plank carpet tile in private office] ][187]

### CARPET TILE BENEFITS

Learn how our innovative, modular carpet tile can make your space more beautiful, comfortable,
sustainable and positive.

[LEARN MORE][188]

### NORA® RUBBER BENEFITS

Produced with precision in Germany for more than 70 years, nora by Interface represents the pinnacle
of high-traffic, high-performance flooring.

[LEARN MORE][189]
[ [Interface Heirloom plank LVT in workplace seating area] ][190]

### LUXURY VINYL TILE BENEFITS

Blend hard and soft surfaces together for a custom approach to flooring that meets a diversity of
needs with our best-in-class LVT.
[LEARN MORE][191]
[ [Interface Antiquities carpet tile ] ][192]

### AREA RUGS BENEFITS

Our integrated system of carpet and LVT allow for seamless rug insets, and our carpet tile can float
freely on any hard surface.
[LEARN MORE][193]

## Get To Know Us

[Mohawk Industries Headquarters]

### Who Are We?

Mohawk is the world’s largest flooring company and so much more. With leading market positions on
four continents, Mohawk offers a comprehensive array of fashionable, high performance and
sustainable flooring options for residential and commercial spaces as well as a growing selection of
products for surfaces beyond the floor.

[Learn More][120]
[Ceramic Tile Floor]

### Ceramic Tile

As the world’s largest ceramic tile provider, Mohawk combines the finest Italian design with
state-of-the-art manufacturing technology.

[Learn More][121]
[Residential Carpet]

### Residential Carpet

Mohawk’s award-winning carpets add warmth and style to any home while offering luxurious softness
and superior stain protection.

[Learn More][122]
[Commercial Flooring]

### Commercial Flooring

Mohawk combines innovative design and exceptional performance in a variety of soft and hard surface
options for every commercial space.

[Learn More][123]
[Area Rug]

### Area Rugs, Bath Rugs & Mats

As the world’s largest rug manufacturer, Mohawk creates elegant home fashion crafted with super soft
and stain-resistant fibers.

## Get To Know Us

[Mohawk Industries Headquarters]

### Who Are We?

Mohawk is the world’s largest flooring company and so much more. With leading market positions on
four continents, Mohawk offers a comprehensive array of fashionable, high performance and
sustainable flooring options for residential and commercial spaces as well as a growing selection of
products for surfaces beyond the floor.

[Learn More][120]
[Ceramic Tile Floor]

### Ceramic Tile

As the world’s largest ceramic tile provider, Mohawk combines the finest Italian design with
state-of-the-art manufacturing technology.

[Learn More][121]
[Residential Carpet]

### Residential Carpet

Mohawk’s award-winning carpets add warmth and style to any home while offering luxurious softness
and superior stain protection.

[Learn More][122]
[Commercial Flooring]

### Commercial Flooring

Mohawk combines innovative design and exceptional performance in a variety of soft and hard surface
options for every commercial space.

[Learn More][123]
[Area Rug]

### Area Rugs, Bath Rugs & Mats

As the world’s largest rug manufacturer, Mohawk creates elegant home fashion crafted with super soft
and stain-resistant fibers.

[Learn More][124]
[Laminate Floor]

### Laminate

With realistic surface visuals and textures and a unique water proof construction, Mohawk’s laminate
flooring outperforms even Mother Nature.

[Learn More][125]
[Luxury Vinyl Tile Floor]

### Luxury Vinyl Tile

In both rigid and flexible LVT, Mohawk offers exceptional visuals that replicate wood, stone and
porcelain while delivering outstanding performance and water resistance.

[Learn More][126]
[Sheet Vinyl Floor]

### Sheet Vinyl

Mohawk is an international leader in sheet vinyl, with advanced technology and superior design that
produces realistic visuals, deeper textures and bolder colors.

[Learn More][127]
[Wood Floor]

### Wood

Mohawk pioneered waterproof wood flooring and offers beautiful contemporary visuals in popular
longer and wider planks.

[Learn More][128]
[Bathroom Countertop]

### Countertops

An extensive assortment of quartz, porcelain and natural stone options in countertops and slabs
provides beautiful, durable and versatile surfaces for homes and commercial spaces.

[Learn More][129]
[Panels]

### Panels

A broad range of chipboard, MDF, melamine-faced, HPL panels and mezzanine flooring solutions for
construction, interior design, furniture, cabinetry and other residential and commercial
applications.

[Learn More][130]
[Insulation]

### Insulation

A wide variety of high thermal performance PIR insulation products for residential and commercial
new construction and renovation projects available for wall, roof, attic and floor installation.

[Learn More][131]

## Our Business Segments

### Global
### Ceramic

Sales of ceramic and porcelain floor, wall and exterior tile products, stone surfaces, quartz
countertops and porcelain panels in all worldwide markets.

### Flooring
### North America

Sales of carpet, carpet cushion, carpet tile, rugs, laminate, sheet vinyl, luxury vinyl tile and
wood flooring in the North American market.

### Flooring
### Rest of the World

Sales of laminate, luxury vinyl tile, sheet vinyl, carpet, carpet tile, wood flooring, panels and
insulation products in all markets outside North America.

## Get To Know Us

[Mohawk Industries Headquarters]

### Who Are We?

Mohawk is the world’s largest flooring company and so much more. With leading market positions on
four continents, Mohawk offers a comprehensive array of fashionable, high performance and
sustainable flooring options for residential and commercial spaces as well as a growing selection of
products for surfaces beyond the floor.

[Learn More][120]
[Ceramic Tile Floor]

### Ceramic Tile

As the world’s largest ceramic tile provider, Mohawk combines the finest Italian design with
state-of-the-art manufacturing technology.

[Learn More][121]
[Residential Carpet]

### Residential Carpet

Mohawk’s award-winning carpets add warmth and style to any home while offering luxurious softness
and superior stain protection.

[Learn More][122]
[Commercial Flooring]

### Commercial Flooring

Mohawk combines innovative design and exceptional performance in a variety of soft and hard surface
options for every commercial space.

[Learn More][123]
[Area Rug]

### Area Rugs, Bath Rugs & Mats

As the world’s largest rug manufacturer, Mohawk creates elegant home fashion crafted with super soft
and stain-resistant fibers.

[Learn More][124]
[Laminate Floor]

### Laminate

With realistic surface visuals and textures and a unique water proof construction, Mohawk’s laminate
flooring outperforms even Mother Nature.

[Learn More][125]
[Luxury Vinyl Tile Floor]

### Luxury Vinyl Tile

In both rigid and flexible LVT, Mohawk offers exceptional visuals that replicate wood, stone and
porcelain while delivering outstanding performance and water resistance.

[Learn More][126]
[Sheet Vinyl Floor]

### Sheet Vinyl

Mohawk is an international leader in sheet vinyl, with advanced technology and superior design that
produces realistic visuals, deeper textures and bolder colors.

[Learn More][127]
[Wood Floor]

### Wood

Mohawk pioneered waterproof wood flooring and offers beautiful contemporary visuals in popular
longer and wider planks.

[Learn More][128]
[Bathroom Countertop]

### Countertops

An extensive assortment of quartz, porcelain and natural stone options in countertops and slabs
provides beautiful, durable and versatile surfaces for homes and commercial spaces.

[Learn More][129]
[Panels]

### Panels

A broad range of chipboard, MDF, melamine-faced, HPL panels and mezzanine flooring solutions for
construction, interior design, furniture, cabinetry and other residential and commercial
applications.

[Learn More][130]
[Insulation]

### Insulation

A wide variety of high thermal performance PIR insulation products for residential and commercial
new construction and renovation projects available for wall, roof, attic and floor installation.

[Learn More][131]

## Our Business Segments

### Global
### Ceramic

Sales of ceramic and porcelain floor, wall and exterior tile products, stone surfaces, quartz
countertops and porcelain panels in all worldwide markets.

### Flooring
### North America

Sales of carpet, carpet cushion, carpet tile, rugs, laminate, sheet vinyl, luxury vinyl tile and
wood flooring in the North American market.

### Flooring
### Rest of the World

Sales of laminate, luxury vinyl tile, sheet vinyl, carpet, carpet tile, wood flooring, panels and
insulation products in all markets outside North America.

# Tarkett Flooring for Commercial and Residential spaces

Tarkett is a world leader in innovative commercial flooring and sports surface solutions that meet
design and functional requirements in multiple market segments: [Healthcare][165], [Aged
Care,][166] the [Workplace][167], [Education][168], [Stores and Shops][169], [Hospitality and
Leisure][170], [Residential][171] and [Sports ][172]segments. Tarkett offers an extensive range of
commercial flooring products including [Homogeneous][173] & [Heterogeneous][174] vinyl
rolls, [luxury vinyl
tiles,][175] [linoleum][176][,][177] [carpet][178], [wood][179] and[ laminate.][180] Committed to
making a positive impact on people and the planet, Tarkett is present in more than 100 countries,
creating people friendly living spaces worldwide that combine well-being, health, performance and
design.

# Tarkett Flooring for Commercial and Residential spaces

Tarkett is a world leader in innovative commercial flooring and sports surface solutions that meet
design and functional requirements in multiple market segments: [Healthcare][165], [Aged
Care,][166] the [Workplace][167], [Education][168], [Stores and Shops][169], [Hospitality and
Leisure][170], [Residential][171] and [Sports ][172]segments. Tarkett offers an extensive range of
commercial flooring products including [Homogeneous][173] & [Heterogeneous][174] vinyl
rolls, [luxury vinyl
tiles,][175] [linoleum][176][,][177] [carpet][178], [wood][179] and[ laminate.][180] Committed to
making a positive impact on people and the planet, Tarkett is present in more than 100 countries,
creating people friendly living spaces worldwide that combine well-being, health, performance and
design.

# honoring our Past. Innovating for the future

AHF Products is home to the most trusted names in flooring built on a 150-year legacy of innovation,
technical mastery, and surfaces engineered to perform. From Bruce® Hardwood to Armstrong
Flooring®, and Crossville® Porcelain Tile.

[Learn More ][33]
* [Portland Cliff Echo tile in outdoor patio with outdoor kitchen]
  Crossville^{®} 
  
  Crossville is a leading brand of porcelain stone, glass, and natural stone tile for both
  residential and commercial settings in interior and exterior floors, walls, and countertops. Made
  from natural elements, our surface covering products yield a variety of unique textures, looks,
  and functions for designers and architects.
  
  [Visit Website][34]
* [Crossville Porcelain Tile Cleve Shadow Glen in a residential kitchen.]
  Crossville Studios 
  
  Crossville Studios is a tile and countertops distributor with 26 locations nationwide. Our staff
  can help you find the right surface material for the right application — commercial or
  residential.
  
  [View Website][35]
* Bruce^{®} 
  
  The Bruce brand has been serving America’s flooring needs since 1865. The Pro’s Choice for
  decades, Bruce is synonymous with quality and craftsmanship. From solid and engineered hardwood to
  laminated wood flooring and luxury vinyl tile, the Bruce brand has been the trusted name in
  flooring for decades.
  
  [Visit Website][36]
* Armstrong Flooring^{®} 
  
  The Armstrong Flooring™ brand has been serving the needs of the residential and commercial markets
  for over a century. The name Armstrong is known as a leader in flooring products. America was
  built on these floors with industries such as healthcare, hospitality, retail and offices spaces
  depending on these quality products, many of which are produced right here in the United States.
  
  [Visit Website][37]
* Hartco^{®} 
  
  The Hartco brand thrives as a leader in flooring for distributor partners throughout the United
  States. From solid and engineered hardwood to laminated wood flooring and luxury vinyl tile,
  America can count on Hartco for durable, premium flooring options.
  
  [Visit Website][38]
* Robbins^{®} 
  
  The Robbins brand has been operating in America since 1886. Robbins offers solid and engineered
  hardwood flooring, laminated wood flooring, and luxury vinyl tile directly to our independent
  retail partners.
  
  [Visit Website][39]
* LMFlooring^{®} 
  
  LM Flooring manufactures flooring the way nature intended it. Our engineered hardwoods feature a
  durable plywood core with a top layer of natural hardwood. That core delivers greater stability to
  your flooring, meaning it’s less likely to expand and contract when exposed to moisture, humidity,
  and temperature extremes.
  
  [Visit Website][40]
* tmbr^{®} 
  
  Tmbr. flooring is the true natural flooring selection for your home. We bring the outdoors inside
  with rich, natural hardwood floors that wrap you in the beauty of America’s national parks.
  
  [Visit Website][41]
* Parterre^{®} 
  
  The Parterre® brand offers a robust selection of commercial luxury vinyl flooring and engineered
  hardwood for a range of spaces and industries. Dozens of architect and design firms have been
  trusting Parterre for their flooring needs since 1992.
  
  [Visit Website][42]
* AHF Contract^{®} 
  
  As one of our commercial brands, choose from a broad selection of styles and colors to bring large
  or small spaces to life. Our lineup of vinyl flooring enhances any commercial space, including
  healthcare, assisted living, education, corporate, hospitality, restaurant, retail, and more.
  
  [Visit Website][43]
* Autograph^{®} 
  
  You’re a unique individual and your floors should match your personality. With Autograph Flooring,
  express yourself with the biggest design element in your home – your floors. Choose from unique
  styles in different types of flooring materials to show off your unique style and taste.
  
  [Visit Website][44]

CRAFTING OUR LEGACY DAILY

Craftsmanship is at the heart of AHF. We manufacture beautiful, durable hard surface solutions in a
range of textures, styles, and designs to meet the needs of the consumer and commercial markets.

[View All Brands][45]

AHF is now at the core of innovation! We’re

AHF Products is home to the most trusted names in flooring built on a 150-year legacy of innovation,
technical mastery, and surfaces engineered to perform. From Bruce® Hardwood to Armstrong
Flooring®, and Crossville® Porcelain Tile.

* [Portland Cliff Echo tile in outdoor patio with outdoor kitchen]
  Crossville^{®} 
  
  Crossville is a leading brand of porcelain stone, glass, and natural stone tile for both
  residential and commercial settings in interior and exterior floors, walls, and countertops. Made
  from natural elements, our surface covering products yield a variety of unique textures, looks,
  and functions for designers and architects.

* [Crossville Porcelain Tile Cleve Shadow Glen in a residential kitchen.]

  Crossville Studios is a tile and countertops distributor with 26 locations nationwide. Our staff
  can help you find the right surface material for the right application — commercial or
  residential.
  
  [View Website][35]
* Bruce^{®} 
  
  The Bruce brand has been serving America’s flooring needs since 1865. The Pro’s Choice for
  decades, Bruce is synonymous with quality and craftsmanship. From solid and engineered hardwood to
  laminated wood flooring and luxury vinyl tile, the Bruce brand has been the trusted name in
  flooring for decades.
  
  [Visit Website][36]
* Armstrong Flooring^{®} 
  
  The Armstrong Flooring™ brand has been serving the needs of the residential and commercial markets
  for over a century. The name Armstrong is known as a leader in flooring products. America was
  built on these floors with industries such as healthcare, hospitality, retail and offices spaces
  depending on these quality products, many of which are produced right here in the United States.
  
  [Visit Website][37]
* Hartco^{®} 
  
  The Hartco brand thrives as a leader in flooring for distributor partners throughout the United
  States. From solid and engineered hardwood to laminated wood flooring and luxury vinyl tile,
  America can count on Hartco for durable, premium flooring options.
  
  [Visit Website][38]
* Robbins^{®} 
  
  The Robbins brand has been operating in America since 1886. Robbins offers solid and engineered
  hardwood flooring, laminated wood flooring, and luxury vinyl tile directly to our independent
  retail partners.
  
  [Visit Website][39]
* LMFlooring^{®} 
  
  LM Flooring manufactures flooring the way nature intended it. Our engineered hardwoods feature a
  durable plywood core with a top layer of natural hardwood. That core delivers greater stability to
  your flooring, meaning it’s less likely to expand and contract when exposed to moisture, humidity,
  and temperature extremes.
  
  [Visit Website][40]
* tmbr^{®} 
  
  Tmbr. flooring is the true natural flooring selection for your home. We bring the outdoors inside
  with rich, natural hardwood floors that wrap you in the beauty of America’s national parks.
  
  [Visit Website][41]
* Parterre^{®} 
  
  The Parterre® brand offers a robust selection of commercial luxury vinyl flooring and engineered
  hardwood for a range of spaces and industries. Dozens of architect and design firms have been
  trusting Parterre for their flooring needs since 1992.
  
  [Visit Website][42]
* AHF Contract^{®} 
  
  As one of our commercial brands, choose from a broad selection of styles and colors to bring large
  or small spaces to life. Our lineup of vinyl flooring enhances any commercial space, including
  healthcare, assisted living, education, corporate, hospitality, restaurant, retail, and more.
  
  [Visit Website][43]
* Autograph^{®} 
  
  You’re a unique individual and your floors should match your personality. With Autograph Flooring,
  express yourself with the biggest design element in your home – your floors. Choose from unique
  styles in different types of flooring materials to show off your unique style and taste.
  
  [Visit Website][44]

[WPC & SPC & LVT][105]

Our WPC, SPC, and LVT flooring collections combine realistic wood and stone visuals, durable wear
layers, easy installation options, and reliable waterproof performance for demanding global markets.

LVT is a multi-layer vinyl flooring category, while SPC uses a rigid core construction with
limestone and stabilizers, and WPC uses a core blended with wood fibers, plastic polymers, and
foaming agents for a softer underfoot feel.

Discover premium luxury vinyl waterproof flooring designed for modern interiors, retail spaces,
hospitality projects, and large-scale commercial applications. 
* **·  **100% waterproof performance for kitchens, bathrooms, basements, entrances, and commercial
  areas.
* **·  **Available in wood effect, stone effect, plank, tile, and herringbone styles.
* **·  **Suitable for commercial-grade projects that need stability, durability, and easy
  maintenance.



### Applications

Our Luxury Vinyl Hardwood Flooring is a practical choice for homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail
stores, healthcare spaces, and other indoor environments with moderate to heavy foot traffic. It is
especially suitable for projects that require easy cleaning, dimensional stability, scratch
resistance, and a modern premium appearance.

Looking for a reliable WPC SPC LVT flooring manufacturer for your next project? Contact us for
[Commercial Flooring Product][106] specs, OEM options, samples, and a competitive quotation.

Choose a reliable partner for high-quality commercial luxury vinyl waterproof flooring designed for
global markets. We provide OEM and private-label manufacturing services for importers, wholesalers,
contractors, distributors, and flooring brands. Our production advantages include customized colors,
sizes, surface finishes, packaging solutions, fast lead times, stable mass production, and strict
quality control at every stage.  Certifications such as ISO 9001, FloorScore, GreenGuard, and FSC
can be supported according to project and market requirements.

### Point de Hongrie : L'élégance intemporelle

Le parquet Point de Hongrie incarne une élégance intemporelle et un raffinement discret. Ce motif de
pose classique ajoute une touche sophistiquée à tout type d’intérieur, qu’il soit traditionnel ou
moderne.


En tant que manufacture de parquet français personnalisable et sur-mesure, nous adaptons le parquet
de votre choix – couleur, naturel, authentique – au motif de pose qui vous plait : panneau, point de
Hongrie, bâton rompu, …

[Parquets Point de Hongrie][95]

## Manufacture française de parquet

Chez Design Parquet, la personnalisation et le sur-mesure sont au cœur de notre savoir-faire.

Depuis près de 30 ans, nous proposons des parquets adaptés aux demandes de tous : architectes,
professionnels du bâtiment, pouvoir publics, monuments historiques et particuliers.
Nos menuisiers s’appliquent pour donner vie à votre projet de parquet lame par lame en prêtant
attention à chaque détail.

Notre équipe d’artisans-menuisiers passionnés vous permet :
* de créer votre parquet de A à Z grâce à nos parquets **Sur-Mesure** ;
* de **personnaliser** les parquets de nos gammes existantes pour les adapter à vos besoins : Design
  Deco, Chêne Naturel, Authentique, Panneaux ou encore Feuillus et Exotiques ;
* d’opter pour un parquet **standard** qui répond d’ores et déjà aux critères recherchés.

Avec plus d’**1 000 000 de possibilités pour créer votre parquet**, Design Parquet a toujours la
solution, le prix et le délai qui vous convient.

[Découvrir les parquets][96]

## 1 000 000 de possibilités pour créer votre parquet

Créer ou personnalisez votre parquet
* Choix de bois : donnez du caractère à votre parquet en optant pour un choix avec + ou – de
  singularités suivant vos envies.
* Couleur : blanc, gris, marron, fumé / thermo ou naturel, Design Parquet a le parquet qu’il vous
  faut.
* Les aspects de surface : donnez de la texture à votre parquet avec nos aspects à grain (brossé,
  structuré ou relief) ou de sciage. Offrez-lui de la personnalité avec nos aspects vieillis light
  ou strong.
* Les finitions : plutôt verni ou huilé ? Optez pour une finition incolore ou mate, mais également
  satiné, brillante ou ROC.
  Pour un projet grand trafic, le vernis ROC est la finition parfaite pour passer en classe 34 et
  valider vos chantiers.
* Les motifs de pose : à l’anglaise (lames droites), à la française (3 largeurs), point de Hongrie,
  bâton rompu ou panneau, … Design Parquet donne vie à vos envies.
* Le support : laissez vous tenter par un parquet massif ou semi-massif pour votre intérieur.
* Les dimensions : épaisseur, largeur, longueur – faites nous part de votre projet et notre bureau
  d’étude en fera une réalité.

[Demander un Devis][97]

## Le parquet est le seul revêtement de sol durable

Fait à partir de bois issus de forêts gérées durablement, il **dure dans le temps**, il est
**rénovable** et **recyclable**.

Chez Design Parquet, notre savoir-faire est mis au service de vos projets de parquet en nous
engageant pour un parquet de qualité dans chacune de nos actions.

Avec des essences certifiées FSC et PEFC suivant vos exigences et l’obtention de notre médaille de
[bronze RSE EcoVadis][98] en 2024 et 2025, nous témoignons de nos engagements envers des pratiques
écoresponsables, sociales et éthiques.

En conformité avec la norme RE 2020, nos parquets ont également obtenus la note A+ au classement COV
(composés organiques volatils).

[Nos engagements][99]

### Point de Hongrie : L'élégance intemporelle

Le parquet Point de Hongrie incarne une élégance intemporelle et un raffinement discret. Ce motif de
pose classique ajoute une touche sophistiquée à tout type d’intérieur, qu’il soit traditionnel ou
moderne.


En tant que manufacture de parquet français personnalisable et sur-mesure, nous adaptons le parquet
de votre choix – couleur, naturel, authentique – au motif de pose qui vous plait : panneau, point de
Hongrie, bâton rompu, …

[Parquets Point de Hongrie][95]

## Manufacture française de parquet

Chez Design Parquet, la personnalisation et le sur-mesure sont au cœur de notre savoir-faire.

Depuis près de 30 ans, nous proposons des parquets adaptés aux demandes de tous : architectes,
professionnels du bâtiment, pouvoir publics, monuments historiques et particuliers.
Nos menuisiers s’appliquent pour donner vie à votre projet de parquet lame par lame en prêtant
attention à chaque détail.

Notre équipe d’artisans-menuisiers passionnés vous permet :
* de créer votre parquet de A à Z grâce à nos parquets **Sur-Mesure** ;
* de **personnaliser** les parquets de nos gammes existantes pour les adapter à vos besoins : Design
  Deco, Chêne Naturel, Authentique, Panneaux ou encore Feuillus et Exotiques ;
* d’opter pour un parquet **standard** qui répond d’ores et déjà aux critères recherchés.

Avec plus d’**1 000 000 de possibilités pour créer votre parquet**, Design Parquet a toujours la
solution, le prix et le délai qui vous convient.

[Découvrir les parquets][96]

## 1 000 000 de possibilités pour créer votre parquet

Créer ou personnalisez votre parquet
* Choix de bois : donnez du caractère à votre parquet en optant pour un choix avec + ou – de
  singularités suivant vos envies.
* Couleur : blanc, gris, marron, fumé / thermo ou naturel, Design Parquet a le parquet qu’il vous
  faut.
* Les aspects de surface : donnez de la texture à votre parquet avec nos aspects à grain (brossé,
  structuré ou relief) ou de sciage. Offrez-lui de la personnalité avec nos aspects vieillis light
  ou strong.
* Les finitions : plutôt verni ou huilé ? Optez pour une finition incolore ou mate, mais également
  satiné, brillante ou ROC.
  Pour un projet grand trafic, le vernis ROC est la finition parfaite pour passer en classe 34 et
  valider vos chantiers.
* Les motifs de pose : à l’anglaise (lames droites), à la française (3 largeurs), point de Hongrie,
  bâton rompu ou panneau, … Design Parquet donne vie à vos envies.
* Le support : laissez vous tenter par un parquet massif ou semi-massif pour votre intérieur.
* Les dimensions : épaisseur, largeur, longueur – faites nous part de votre projet et notre bureau
  d’étude en fera une réalité.

[Demander un Devis][97]

## Le parquet est le seul revêtement de sol durable

Fait à partir de bois issus de forêts gérées durablement, il **dure dans le temps**, il est
**rénovable** et **recyclable**.

Chez Design Parquet, notre savoir-faire est mis au service de vos projets de parquet en nous
engageant pour un parquet de qualité dans chacune de nos actions.

Avec des essences certifiées FSC et PEFC suivant vos exigences et l’obtention de notre médaille de
[bronze RSE EcoVadis][98] en 2024 et 2025, nous témoignons de nos engagements envers des pratiques
écoresponsables, sociales et éthiques.

En conformité avec la norme RE 2020, nos parquets ont également obtenus la note A+ au classement COV
(composés organiques volatils).

[Nos engagements][99]

### Proces produkcji

# Producent podłóg i parkietów drewnianych w Rzeszowie i Krośnie – Drewger

Od 1996 roku zajmujemy się przetwarzaniem polskiego drewna. W tym czasie sukcesywnie rozszerzaliśmy
naszą ofertę o nowe produkty, oparte o profesjonalną obróbkę surowca drzewnego. Nasza firma oferuje
wysokiej jakości produkty oraz wyspecjalizowaną, fachową obsługę. Znajdujemy się w czołówce firm
**produkujących podłogę i parkiet** w południowo-wschodniej Polsce. Jesteśmy sprawdzonym
producentem!

Firma Drewger to firma rodzinna, która została zbudowana od podstaw ponad 20 lat temu. Zaczynaliśmy
od zatrudnienia kilku pracowników, by rozwinąć się do ponad 40-osobowego, zgranego zespołu fachowców
i pasjonatów.

To, że produkujemy wyłącznie z polskiego surowca, jest efektem naszego przywiązania do polskiej
tradycji, oraz chęci fachowej specjalizacji w obróbce naszych rodzimych gatunków drewna. Od początku
stawiamy na jakość, trwałość i satysfakcję naszych klientów.

Cieszymy się z każdego zadowolonego klienta, bo Państwa satysfakcja oznacza, że nasza praca ma sens.
Dodatkowo cieszy nas to, że nasze produkty są niemymi świadkami tylu miłych chwil w Państwa życiu.

## Zaproś nasz parkiet do swojego domu

W ciągu ponad 25 lat **zagościliśmy w wielu polskich domach i firmach**. Z dumą, choć nie osobiście,
towarzyszymy Państwu każdego dnia. Nasze **podłogi** zdobią wiele pięknych wnętrz – od domów
prywatnych, przez lokale usługowe, aż po większe obiekty. Do każdego zlecenia podchodzimy z ogromną
starannością, dając upust swojej pasji.

Zrealizujemy każdą wizję. Niezależnie od tego, co państwo zaplanują, podejmujemy się wyzwania!
Wykonamy wszelkie projekty podłóg i [parkietów w Rzeszowie][22], **Krośnie** oraz okolicach.

## Podłogi Krosno, Rzeszów i okolice – dla kogo je tworzymy?

Jesteśmy rodzinną firmą, która uwielbia tworzyć dla rodzin. Układanie podłogi jest jednym z
pierwszych etapów wykańczania wnętrz. To właśnie gotowe ściany i posadzka sprawiają, że surowe
wnętrze zaczyna przypominać rodzinny dom. Cieszymy się, że możemy rozpoczynać wraz z Państwem ten
fascynujący okres. Równie chętnie współpracujemy z przedsiębiorcami. Przecież sami nimi jesteśmy!
Dzięki temu doskonale rozumiemy, jakie są Państwa potrzeby.

## Co nas wyróżnia?

01.

Polskie drewno

Produkujemy wyłącznie z najlepszego polskiego drewna, nawiązując do wieloletnich rodzimych tradycji.
Dzięki współpracy z polskimi kontrahentami mamy pewność, jaki materiał drzewny trafi w nasze ręce.
Możemy stale kontrolować jakość i stan zamawianych surowców, ponieważ doskonale wiemy, skąd i od
kogo pochodzi.

02.

Jakość i wytrzymałość

Dbamy o jakość i wytrzymałość naszych produktów, starannie dobierając surowce i kontrolując
prawidłowy przebieg każdego etapu produkcji. Nasza troska o finalny efekt gotowego produktu zaczyna
się u samych podstaw. Wybieramy jedynie wyselekcjonowane materiały drzewne od najlepszych dostawców,
aby móc pracować na najwyższej jakości surowcu.

03.

Relacje z Klientami

Nie żegnamy się z Państwem po sfinalizowaniu transakcji. Służymy pomocą także po dokonaniu zakupu. Z
przyjemnością doradzamy, jak pielęgnować podłogi. Podpowiadamy, w jaki sposób dbać o ich stan, aby
posłużyły Państwu jak najdłużej. W tym zakresie wskazujemy zarówno odpowiednie techniki, jak i
środki pielęgnacyjne oraz konserwujące.

# Producent podłóg i parkietów drewnianych w Rzeszowie i Krośnie – Drewger

Od 1996 roku zajmujemy się przetwarzaniem polskiego drewna. W tym czasie sukcesywnie rozszerzaliśmy
naszą ofertę o nowe produkty, oparte o profesjonalną obróbkę surowca drzewnego. Nasza firma oferuje
wysokiej jakości produkty oraz wyspecjalizowaną, fachową obsługę. Znajdujemy się w czołówce firm
**produkujących podłogę i parkiet** w południowo-wschodniej Polsce. Jesteśmy sprawdzonym
producentem!

Firma Drewger to firma rodzinna, która została zbudowana od podstaw ponad 20 lat temu. Zaczynaliśmy
od zatrudnienia kilku pracowników, by rozwinąć się do ponad 40-osobowego, zgranego zespołu fachowców
i pasjonatów.

To, że produkujemy wyłącznie z polskiego surowca, jest efektem naszego przywiązania do polskiej
tradycji, oraz chęci fachowej specjalizacji w obróbce naszych rodzimych gatunków drewna. Od początku
stawiamy na jakość, trwałość i satysfakcję naszych klientów.

Cieszymy się z każdego zadowolonego klienta, bo Państwa satysfakcja oznacza, że nasza praca ma sens.
Dodatkowo cieszy nas to, że nasze produkty są niemymi świadkami tylu miłych chwil w Państwa życiu.

## Zaproś nasz parkiet do swojego domu

W ciągu ponad 25 lat **zagościliśmy w wielu polskich domach i firmach**. Z dumą, choć nie osobiście,
towarzyszymy Państwu każdego dnia. Nasze **podłogi** zdobią wiele pięknych wnętrz – od domów
prywatnych, przez lokale usługowe, aż po większe obiekty. Do każdego zlecenia podchodzimy z ogromną
starannością, dając upust swojej pasji.

Zrealizujemy każdą wizję. Niezależnie od tego, co państwo zaplanują, podejmujemy się wyzwania!
Wykonamy wszelkie projekty podłóg i [parkietów w Rzeszowie][22], **Krośnie** oraz okolicach.

## Podłogi Krosno, Rzeszów i okolice – dla kogo je tworzymy?

Jesteśmy rodzinną firmą, która uwielbia tworzyć dla rodzin. Układanie podłogi jest jednym z
pierwszych etapów wykańczania wnętrz. To właśnie gotowe ściany i posadzka sprawiają, że surowe
wnętrze zaczyna przypominać rodzinny dom. Cieszymy się, że możemy rozpoczynać wraz z Państwem ten
fascynujący okres. Równie chętnie współpracujemy z przedsiębiorcami. Przecież sami nimi jesteśmy!
Dzięki temu doskonale rozumiemy, jakie są Państwa potrzeby.

## Co nas wyróżnia?

01.

Polskie drewno

Produkujemy wyłącznie z najlepszego polskiego drewna, nawiązując do wieloletnich rodzimych tradycji.
Dzięki współpracy z polskimi kontrahentami mamy pewność, jaki materiał drzewny trafi w nasze ręce.
Możemy stale kontrolować jakość i stan zamawianych surowców, ponieważ doskonale wiemy, skąd i od
kogo pochodzi.

02.

Dbamy o jakość i wytrzymałość naszych produktów, starannie dobierając surowce i kontrolując

Relacje z Klientami

Nie żegnamy się z Państwem po sfinalizowaniu transakcji. Służymy pomocą także po dokonaniu zakupu. Z
przyjemnością doradzamy, jak pielęgnować podłogi. Podpowiadamy, w jaki sposób dbać o ich stan, aby
posłużyły Państwu jak najdłużej. W tym zakresie wskazujemy zarówno odpowiednie techniki, jak i

## Discover Dubai Flooring's Diverse Range of Exquisite Flooring Options

We offer a wide variety of flooring options to suit any taste and budget. Here are some of the types
of flooring we offer and a brief description of each:

[ [Birch Hardwood Flooring] ][109]

### [Wooden Flooring][110]

**[Wooden flooring][111]** is a classic choice for any home. It is durable and timeless, with a
natural warmth that adds character to any space.

[ [Parquet Flooring in Bedroom] ][112]

### [Parquet Flooring][113]

**Parquet Flooring:** **[Parquet flooring][114]** is made up of small wooden blocks arranged in
intricate patterns. It is a stunning and unique option that adds a touch of elegance to any room.

[ [SPC Flooring in Hall Ways] ][115]

### [SPC Flooring][116]

**[SPC flooring][117]** is a type of rigid vinyl flooring that is highly durable and waterproof. It
is available in a range of designs and is ideal for high-traffic areas like offices, retail spaces,
and schools.

[ [Laminate Flooring in Dining Room] ][118]

### [Laminate Flooring][119]

**Laminate Flooring:** Laminate flooring is made up of multiple layers of synthetic material that
mimic the look of wood or stone. It is a durable and affordable option that is easy to install.

[ [LVT Flooring in Kitchen] ][120]

### [LVT Flooring][121]

**[LVT flooring][122]** is a type of luxury vinyl flooring that mimics the look of natural materials
like wood and stone. It is durable and affordable, making it a popular choice for residential and
commercial spaces.

[ [Hospital Vinyl Flooring] ][123]

### [Vinyl Flooring][124]

Vinyl flooring is a synthetic material that is durable and affordable. It is available in a range of
designs, from wood and stone to bold patterns, making it a versatile choice for any space.

[ [PVC Flooring] ][125]

### [PVC Flooring][126]

**[PVC flooring][127]** is a synthetic material that is waterproof and easy to clean, making it an
ideal choice for kitchens and bathrooms. It is available in a range of designs, including wood,
stone, and bold colors.

[ [Epoxy Painting Classroom] ][128]

### [Epoxy Flooring][129]

**[Epoxy flooring][130]** is a seamless, durable, and low-maintenance option that is ideal for
high-traffic areas like commercial buildings, garages, and workshops. It is also available in a
range of colors and patterns.

[ [WPC Flooring in outdoor space] ][131]

### [WPC Flooring][132]

**[WPC flooring][133]** is a blend of wood and plastic that is durable and easy to maintain. It is
available in a range of designs, including wood and stone, making it a versatile option for any
space.

[ [Rubber Flooring GYM] ][134]

### [Rubber Flooring][135]

Rubber flooring is a durable and slip-resistant option that is ideal for high-traffic areas like
gyms, schools, and hospitals. It is available in a range of colors and patterns and is easy to
maintain.

[ [Bamboo Flooring in Living Room] ][136]

### [Bamboo Flooring][137]

Bamboo flooring is an eco-friendly and sustainable alternative to traditional hardwood, known for
its strength, style, and environmental benefits.

[ [Raised Flooring in Office] ][138]

### [Raised Flooring][139]

Raised flooring, also known as access flooring, is a practical and flexible solution for commercial
and high-tech environments where cable management and system access are essential.

## Discover Dubai Flooring's Diverse Range of Exquisite Flooring Options

We offer a wide variety of flooring options to suit any taste and budget. Here are some of the types
of flooring we offer and a brief description of each:

[ [Birch Hardwood Flooring] ][109]

### [Wooden Flooring][110]

**[Wooden flooring][111]** is a classic choice for any home. It is durable and timeless, with a
natural warmth that adds character to any space.

[ [Parquet Flooring in Bedroom] ][112]

### [Parquet Flooring][113]

**Parquet Flooring:** **[Parquet flooring][114]** is made up of small wooden blocks arranged in
intricate patterns. It is a stunning and unique option that adds a touch of elegance to any room.

[ [SPC Flooring in Hall Ways] ][115]

### [SPC Flooring][116]

**[SPC flooring][117]** is a type of rigid vinyl flooring that is highly durable and waterproof. It
is available in a range of designs and is ideal for high-traffic areas like offices, retail spaces,
and schools.

[ [Laminate Flooring in Dining Room] ][118]

### [Laminate Flooring][119]

**Laminate Flooring:** Laminate flooring is made up of multiple layers of synthetic material that
mimic the look of wood or stone. It is a durable and affordable option that is easy to install.

[ [LVT Flooring in Kitchen] ][120]

### [LVT Flooring][121]

**[LVT flooring][122]** is a type of luxury vinyl flooring that mimics the look of natural materials
like wood and stone. It is durable and affordable, making it a popular choice for residential and
commercial spaces.

[ [Hospital Vinyl Flooring] ][123]

### [Vinyl Flooring][124]

Vinyl flooring is a synthetic material that is durable and affordable. It is available in a range of
designs, from wood and stone to bold patterns, making it a versatile choice for any space.

[ [PVC Flooring] ][125]

### [PVC Flooring][126]

**[PVC flooring][127]** is a synthetic material that is waterproof and easy to clean, making it an
ideal choice for kitchens and bathrooms. It is available in a range of designs, including wood,
stone, and bold colors.

[ [Epoxy Painting Classroom] ][128]

### [Epoxy Flooring][129]

**[Epoxy flooring][130]** is a seamless, durable, and low-maintenance option that is ideal for
high-traffic areas like commercial buildings, garages, and workshops. It is also available in a
range of colors and patterns.

[ [WPC Flooring in outdoor space] ][131]

### [WPC Flooring][132]

**[WPC flooring][133]** is a blend of wood and plastic that is durable and easy to maintain. It is
available in a range of designs, including wood and stone, making it a versatile option for any
space.

[ [Rubber Flooring GYM] ][134]

### [Rubber Flooring][135]

Rubber flooring is a durable and slip-resistant option that is ideal for high-traffic areas like
gyms, schools, and hospitals. It is available in a range of colors and patterns and is easy to
maintain.

[ [Bamboo Flooring in Living Room] ][136]

### [Bamboo Flooring][137]

Bamboo flooring is an eco-friendly and sustainable alternative to traditional hardwood, known for
its strength, style, and environmental benefits.

[ [Raised Flooring in Office] ][138]

### [Raised Flooring][139]

Raised flooring, also known as access flooring, is a practical and flexible solution for commercial
and high-tech environments where cable management and system access are essential.

WELCOME TO EURO TIMBER FLOORING
Choosing The right floor is like a life time love afair
Choosing the right timber is one of the most important decisions you will make when Creating the
"WOW" factor of your home, A good quality Classic floor is what you need to make your home look like
it should. THE MASTERPIECE

# Parquetry Flooring

Comprised of many different cuts of timber artfully arranged in geometric patterns our creative team
can design and install captivating parquetry patterns of varying sizes based on our customer’s
desires and directions.

## Oak Parquetry

Renowned for its colouration ranging from light yellow to brown the team at Euro Timber Flooring
specialises in importing Oak hardwood timber ready for cutting and treating. Thanks to its hardiness
and vibrant range of colour Oak is a perfect choice for use in intricate and geometric parquetry
patterns.

## French Oak Parquetry

Thanks for its hardiness and durability, along with its wide range of available colours once it has
been treated Oak timber immediately improves the colour and effectiveness of timber parquetry. At
Euro Timber Flooring we strive to make our beautiful and expressive parquetry stand apart from other
available flooring solutions.

FlooringFirst! provides professional floor sanding, wood floor restoration, fitting and repairs
across every London borough. We restore original floorboards, herringbone parquet, mosaic panels,
engineered and solid hardwood floors using dust-free Bona equipment that captures up to 99% of

][29] Our floor sanding service covers the whole of Greater London, from single rooms to
full-property restorations. You'll work with knowledgeable advisors, a dedicated project manager,
and teams trained on Bona dust-free systems capturing up to 99% of particles — backed by over two
decades of restoration experience. [Book a Free Visit][30]
[

### Floor Fitting

][31] As one of London's leading wood, laminate and LVT flooring suppliers, we handle every aspect
of floor fitting — from straightforward plank installation to complex herringbone parquet with
decorative borders. Tens of thousands of homes and businesses across the capital have transformed
their spaces with our supply-and-fit service. [Book a Free Visit][32]

][33] Floor repairs can form part of a larger restoration or solve a single, specific problem. We
repair solid and engineered planks, replace or refit parquet blocks and mosaic fingers, and resolve
water damage, movement and subfloor issues. Deep diagnostic experience means we can help even with
the trickiest flooring challenges.
[

cleaning and polishing, recoating for lacquered floors and re-oiling for oiled floors — and most of
our restoration services include a free aftercare kit so you can protect the result from day one.

## Floor Sanding & Wood Floor Restoration in London

FLOOR FINISHING FOCUSED ON DETAIL

[Importance of Details in Sanding]

### Renovation Detail

We believe that **perfection lies in the details**. Every floor we restore is treated as a unique
project, whether it's engineered wood, solid hardwood, or parquet flooring. Our team carefully
selects the most effective **floor sanding and refinishing** method to suit the specific needs of
your floor.

We also tailor our process to your preferred finish—lacquered or oiled—ensuring the final result
matches your vision. With the **widest range of wood floor stains and finishing products** available
in London, we guarantee a customised, high-quality result every time.

To keep your home clean and your experience stress-free, we use **advanced dust-free sanding

[Hardwood & Engineered Floor Fitting]

### Solid & Engineered Wood Floor Installation

Our services include glue-down and nail-down installation of hardwood and floating installations for
engineered flooring, with all relevant precautions for damp proofing - moisture testing and
levelling of concrete and timber subfloors.

To provide your installation with Service Guarantee we make sure, we have selected the right
insulation, method of installation and the measurement we have collected are in acceptable limits.

Within our range of solid wood products, we [install Junckers solid wood and sports flooring][95].

We do floor sanding and line marking for sport floors as well.

[Parquet Floor Fitting & Restoration]

### Parquet Floor Fitting, Restoration & Supply

We pride ourselves as parquet floor fitters of extinction - Floorworks™ is already a recognised name
in London, Surrey, Hertfordshire, Berkshire associated with the supply and [fitting of parquet
flooring][96]. We lay variety of patterns including **herringbone** & **chevron**, with or without
decorative border around.

We enjoy everything about the craft of parquetry - the fitting & the restoration of this classic
heritage. We deliver the finest finish with a focus on detail, with our years of experience in
parquet flooring repairs and renovation.

We service comes with on-site consultation & free samples of a wide range of [parquet flooring
products][97].

[Solid Wood Installation]

### Installation & Renovation for
### Universe of Flooring Brands

Our supply & fit service applies to some for big brands and great prices - we do QuickStep, Boen,
Kahrs, Karndean, Amtico and more.

With our floor installation service you don't have to worry about matching accessories, stair
nosings and it comes with **service guarantee** and **delivery inside** your property.

If you are looking into [fitting laminate flooring][98] for your stairs, Floorworks™ will recommend
QuickStep unique Incizo solution for stairs, delivering great results in short completion time.

When it comes to [laying service for LVT & SPC flooring products][99], we make sure your subfloor is
assessed & prepared from survey to completion.

Enjoy our supply & fit flooring products & services offering a choice for every taste - lacquered,
oiled, whitewashed, rustic, prime, handscraped, hand-sawn, tumbled, brushed & oiled, matt lacquered
and unfinished, oak, merbau, maple, walnut, ash and more...

[[gerbur aqua click washed oak vinyl click flooring in chic bedroom]][83]

### [Vinyl Flooring][84]

Vinyl flooring combines natural beauty with everyday practicality. Water-resistant, comfortable
underfoot, and available in lifelike wood and stone finishes, it offers long-lasting performance
with minimal maintenance. With trusted brands like Gerbür, BerryAlloc, and Quick-Step, Floorworld
provides vinyl solutions that deliver durability, style, and reliability for homes and commercial
interiors.

[[person cleaning water off laminate flooring]][85]

### [Laminate Flooring][86]

Laminate flooring offers the perfect balance of beauty, durability, and practicality, capturing the
natural elegance of real wood while providing superior resistance to wear, moisture, and fading.
Easy to install and effortless to maintain, it’s an ideal choice for busy homes and modern
commercial spaces alike.

[[spc engage gerbur oak limed stone plastic composite floor in living room]][87]

### [SPC Flooring][88]

SPC flooring represents the perfect harmony between durability and design innovation. Its 100%
waterproof core makes it ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and open-plan areas, while its click-lock
system allows seamless, glue-free installation.

[[british carpet mills carpet flooring in an office space]][89]

### [Carpet][90]

Carpets bring luxury, comfort, and timeless style to any interior. From premium wall-to-wall carpets
to durable modular carpet tiles, Floorworld offers an exceptional selection from leading global
brands—trusted across the UAE and the wider GCC. Enjoy free site visits, free samples, expert
consultation, and complete professional installation services. The perfect blend of warmth,
elegance, and long-lasting performance for homes, offices, hospitality, and commercial spaces
throughout the region.

[[decking and artificial grass in apartment complex garden]][91]

### [Outdoors][92]

Floorworld’s Outdoor Collection combines Smart Board Composite Decking and Standard Turf Artificial
Grass to elevate terraces, balconies, gardens, rooftops, and poolside spaces across the UAE. With
timber-inspired decking and realistic, low-maintenance turf, the range offers durable,
weather-resistant surfaces that stay vibrant year-round. Designed for comfort, stability, and
lasting outdoor performance, it creates stylish, functional spaces for modern villas, hospitality
areas, and contemporary outdoor living.

[[trims, skirtings, and other flooring accessories in a neat pile]][93]

### [Flooring Accessories][94]

At Floorworld, we understand that the smallest details make the biggest difference. Our high-quality
flooring accessories enhance both the look and performance of your space, providing smooth
transitions, edge protection, and a refined aesthetic. Whether for residential or commercial use,
our trims and profiles are engineered for lasting durability and effortless installation, the
perfect finishing touch to your new floor.

### [Wood Flooring][82]

Floorworld’s wood flooring collection combines natural timber beauty with exceptional craftsmanship.
Featuring both engineered wood and parquet designs from leading brands such as Royal Parquet,
SwissHardwood, ECO Wood, and Universal Flooring, our wood range offers enduring quality, rich
character, and timeless style suited for homes and commercial spaces across the UAE.

[[gerbur aqua click washed oak vinyl click flooring in chic bedroom]][83]

### [Vinyl Flooring][84]

Vinyl flooring combines natural beauty with everyday practicality. Water-resistant, comfortable
underfoot, and available in lifelike wood and stone finishes, it offers long-lasting performance
with minimal maintenance. With trusted brands like Gerbür, BerryAlloc, and Quick-Step, Floorworld
provides vinyl solutions that deliver durability, style, and reliability for homes and commercial
interiors.

[[person cleaning water off laminate flooring]][85]

### [Laminate Flooring][86]

Laminate flooring offers the perfect balance of beauty, durability, and practicality, capturing the
natural elegance of real wood while providing superior resistance to wear, moisture, and fading.
Easy to install and effortless to maintain, it’s an ideal choice for busy homes and modern
commercial spaces alike.

[[spc engage gerbur oak limed stone plastic composite floor in living room]][87]

### [SPC Flooring][88]

SPC flooring represents the perfect harmony between durability and design innovation. Its 100%
waterproof core makes it ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and open-plan areas, while its click-lock
system allows seamless, glue-free installation.

[[british carpet mills carpet flooring in an office space]][89]

### [Carpet][90]

Carpets bring luxury, comfort, and timeless style to any interior. From premium wall-to-wall carpets
to durable modular carpet tiles, Floorworld offers an exceptional selection from leading global
brands—trusted across the UAE and the wider GCC. Enjoy free site visits, free samples, expert
consultation, and complete professional installation services. The perfect blend of warmth,
elegance, and long-lasting performance for homes, offices, hospitality, and commercial spaces
throughout the region.

[[decking and artificial grass in apartment complex garden]][91]

### [Outdoors][92]

Floorworld’s Outdoor Collection combines Smart Board Composite Decking and Standard Turf Artificial
Grass to elevate terraces, balconies, gardens, rooftops, and poolside spaces across the UAE. With
timber-inspired decking and realistic, low-maintenance turf, the range offers durable,
weather-resistant surfaces that stay vibrant year-round. Designed for comfort, stability, and
lasting outdoor performance, it creates stylish, functional spaces for modern villas, hospitality
areas, and contemporary outdoor living.

[[trims, skirtings, and other flooring accessories in a neat pile]][93]

### [Flooring Accessories][94]

At Floorworld, we understand that the smallest details make the biggest difference. Our high-quality
flooring accessories enhance both the look and performance of your space, providing smooth
transitions, edge protection, and a refined aesthetic. Whether for residential or commercial use,
our trims and profiles are engineered for lasting durability and effortless installation, the
perfect finishing touch to your new floor.

[a living space with a wooden floor and measurement graphical overlay]

Book a free professional site visit and receive a no-obligation flooring quotation within 24 hours.
Our flooring specialists visit your home, office, retail shop, or commercial project to take
accurate measurements, inspect site conditions, and recommend the most suitable flooring solutions
for your space.

Explore a wide range of flooring options including SPC Flooring, Laminate Flooring, Vinyl Click
Flooring, Sheet Vinyl, Engineered Wood, Parquet Flooring, Carpets, Carpet Tiles, Outdoor Decking,

### Q: What material is used for Heatwood Parquet flooring?

A: At Heatwood Parquet, we proudly craft our luxurious flooring using Santos Rosewood and Tarara
Colorado wood from South American. Sourced for its natural beauty and exceptional durability, Santos
Rosewood is a premium choice that brings elegance and warmth to any space. Its rich, vibrant hues
and intricate grain patterns make each parquet masterpiece unique, ensuring your floors aren't just
surfaces to walk on, but works of art that enhance the ambiance of your home or office. By choosing
Santos Rosewood, you're investing in quality, aesthetics, and lasting value, all hallmarks of the
Heatwood Parquet experience.

### Q: Where can I buy this beautiful exotic hardwood parquet?

A: At Heatwood Parquet, we specialize in crafting luxurious Santos Rosewood parquet masterpieces
designed to elevate your space with natural beauty. You can purchase our exquisite parquet flooring
directly from our showroom or through our online store. Our team is passionate about providing
top-notch customer service and ensuring you find the perfect hardwood flooring to meet your needs.
Visit our website at www.heatwoodparquet.com or drop by our showroom to explore our stunning
collection of exotic hardwood parquet.

### Q: Can you design and manufacture parquet flooring to my custom specifications?

A: Yes, Heatwood Parquet specializes in creating bespoke parquet flooring tailored to your unique
specifications. We pride ourselves on crafting luxury parquet masterpieces, often using premium
materials such as Santos Rosewood, Tarara Colorado and Teak. Our skilled artisans work closely with
you to understand your vision, incorporating your preferences into a design that harmonizes with
your space. Whether you desire a specific pattern, color, or wood type, our team is committed to
delivering a parquet floor that enhances the natural beauty of your environment, ensuring it is a
true reflection of your personal style.

### Q: When I purchase parquet from Heatwood Parquet, how is the order shipped for overseas
### delivery?

A: At Heatwood Parquet, we take pride in delivering our luxury Santos Rosewood and other species
parquet floors to clients worldwide. Once you place an order, our team will carefully prepare your
parquet to ensure it reaches you in pristine condition. We collaborate with reputable international
shipping carriers to provide you with reliable and efficient service. The shipping process includes
robust packaging, customs documentation, and timely updates on your shipment's status. Please note
that shipping fees and delivery times may vary depending on your location. Our customer service team
is available to assist you with any specific shipping inquiries or to provide a detailed quote
before finalizing your purchase.

### Q: What material is used for Heatwood Parquet flooring?

A: At Heatwood Parquet, we proudly craft our luxurious flooring using Santos Rosewood and Tarara
Colorado wood from South American. Sourced for its natural beauty and exceptional durability, Santos
Rosewood is a premium choice that brings elegance and warmth to any space. Its rich, vibrant hues
and intricate grain patterns make each parquet masterpiece unique, ensuring your floors aren't just
surfaces to walk on, but works of art that enhance the ambiance of your home or office. By choosing
Santos Rosewood, you're investing in quality, aesthetics, and lasting value, all hallmarks of the
Heatwood Parquet experience.

### Q: Where can I buy this beautiful exotic hardwood parquet?

A: At Heatwood Parquet, we specialize in crafting luxurious Santos Rosewood parquet masterpieces
designed to elevate your space with natural beauty. You can purchase our exquisite parquet flooring
directly from our showroom or through our online store. Our team is passionate about providing
top-notch customer service and ensuring you find the perfect hardwood flooring to meet your needs.
Visit our website at www.heatwoodparquet.com or drop by our showroom to explore our stunning
collection of exotic hardwood parquet.

### Q: Can you design and manufacture parquet flooring to my custom specifications?

A: Yes, Heatwood Parquet specializes in creating bespoke parquet flooring tailored to your unique
specifications. We pride ourselves on crafting luxury parquet masterpieces, often using premium
materials such as Santos Rosewood, Tarara Colorado and Teak. Our skilled artisans work closely with
you to understand your vision, incorporating your preferences into a design that harmonizes with
your space. Whether you desire a specific pattern, color, or wood type, our team is committed to
delivering a parquet floor that enhances the natural beauty of your environment, ensuring it is a
true reflection of your personal style.

### Q: When I purchase parquet from Heatwood Parquet, how is the order shipped for overseas
### delivery?

A: At Heatwood Parquet, we take pride in delivering our luxury Santos Rosewood and other species
parquet floors to clients worldwide. Once you place an order, our team will carefully prepare your
parquet to ensure it reaches you in pristine condition. We collaborate with reputable international
shipping carriers to provide you with reliable and efficient service. The shipping process includes
robust packaging, customs documentation, and timely updates on your shipment's status. Please note
that shipping fees and delivery times may vary depending on your location. Our customer service team
is available to assist you with any specific shipping inquiries or to provide a detailed quote
before finalizing your purchase.

Home Decorators has been one of the leading brands in the American market for years. Their
[Christmas Trees][44], faucets, ceiling fans, and dozens of other products were in demand for years.
However, in 2018, the company announced that they were closing their stores and website. The reason
for that was the decision by the parent company, Home Depot, to focus more on the core business.
This is an official manufacturer’s fan website, aimed at collecting all the information about Home
Decorators’ most popular products, home design and decoration ideas, and other related things.

At the moment, Home Decorators Collection products are exclusively available on Home Depot website
and on Amazon. This collection features a timeless design that is always trendy. The product range
includes, but is not limited to the following ones.

[Home]

## Bathroom Selection

Here you can find everything needed to properly equip your bathroom. These are vanity tops with tops
and without tops (for further sink installation), and there are [single and double-sink
vanities][45] to better accommodate your needs. Bathroom vanity tops can be purchased separately.
Besides, a selection of vanity mirrors, shower doors, bathtubs, and bathroom storage solutions is
designed to allow you to purchase everything you need for your bathroom in one place. 

## Flooring and Rugs

This selection by Home Decorators allows the selection of different kinds, materials, and colors of
floor coverage. The most popular types here are [vinyl plank flooring, laminate flooring, bamboo
flooring, and area rugs][46]. There are dozens of colors and materials to choose from. So, if your
space is rather styled in warm colors and tones, you can pick the flooring in beige, oak, walnut,
and other colors and textures that feature a warm undertone. If your interior is in cool shades and
colors or you prefer going with monochrome, see the selection in Rockwater Oak, or other materials
and shades that feature gray undertone. 

## Ceiling Fans and Lighting

This selection is one of the most popular ones, as numerous fans of Home Decorators say. Ceiling
fans by this brand are available in the most popular sizes that meet the needs of different spaces.
There are models designed both for indoor and outdoor usage. [Home Decorators’ ceiling fans][47]
with light are extremely popular these days due to their multifunctionality, simple design, and
energy-saving features. However, models without light are also still on the list of Amazon’s
best-selling ceiling fans up to these days. 

Lighting solutions are not limited to ceiling fans with LED lights, however, There is a variety of
chandeliers and pendant lighting in the selection, as well as flush-mount lights and wall scones.
Lighting design is simple and minimalistic, which allows you to easily fit them into almost any
interior without the fear that lighting will not match other interior elements. If you are looking
for simple yet trendy outdoor lighting solutions, look no further than Home Decorators Collection.
You will find a variety of quality and reasonably priced models there. 

## Furniture and Decor Selection 

Home Decorators Collection features a variety of solutions for various applications, including both
indoor and outdoor ones. Kitchen and Dining room furniture includes dining tables, chairs, shelves,
sideboards, drawer cabinets, TV stands, and a variety of other elements in timeless traditional
style. The living room collection by this brand includes coffee tables, armchairs, sofas, storage
cabinets, and a variety of interior elements in metal, glass, and wood. If you are looking for
bedroom furniture, it is a good idea to pay attention to drawer canes, jewelry armoires, wood beds
in different sizes, nightstands, and multiple other elements available. Home Decorators office
collection features everything needed to equip your home office in a traditional, convenient, and
trendy way. Here you will find desks and chairs, armchairs and shelves, as well as a variety of
styling accents for your home office. In case you are looking for some quality furniture for your
patio, check out the selection of outdoor furniture. You can be sure that the chaise longues, dining
and conversation sets, as well as umbrellas will last long and will look great. And quality gas fire
pit tables will add warmth to your routine when you need it.

Relying on your expectations, select the products that match each other in shape and design and

You can also see the references on the Home Decorators Collection’s official website. See the

So, it’s up to you to choose the best combination for yourself.

Welcome to **Interiors Dubai**, your top choice for comprehensive interior design services and
high-quality fit-out products. We proudly serve Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the entire UAE, offering
everything you need to transform your space into a stunning reflection of your style and
personality. Whether you are renovating your home or designing a new office, we have the expertise
and products to bring your vision to life.

As a leading **interior design company in Dubai**, we understand that every project is unique. Our
team of skilled designers works closely with you to create customized solutions tailored to your
needs. From selecting the right flooring and carpets to choosing the perfect curtains and blinds, we
ensure every detail enhances the overall aesthetic of your space. Our extensive range of decor items
adds the finishing touches that make your environment truly special.

At **Interiors Dubai**, we pride ourselves on being a reliable **fit-out company in Dubai**. Our
high-quality products are sourced from trusted manufacturers, ensuring durability and style. We
offer a wide selection of flooring options, including luxurious carpets, elegant vinyl, and trendy
tiles, to suit any preference. Our curtains and blinds come in various fabrics and designs,
providing both functionality and beauty.

We are committed to delivering exceptional service from start to finish. Our dedicated team ensures
that your project runs smoothly, with timely installations and meticulous attention to detail.
Experience the difference with **Interiors Dubai**. Let us help you create a beautiful, functional
space that you’ll love for years to come. Choose us for all your interior design needs and watch
your dream space come to life!

## WHERE PERFORMANCE MEETS CULTURE | Inside Luka Dončić's 77X Pop-up

"Lil' Luka's Heartbreak Factory" — a candy-factory-meets-basketball-gym powered by a custom black
hardwood court by Junckers.

[TO THE HEARTBREAK FACTORY][200]

## PRODUCT LAUNCH | Introducing Junckers Printed Sports Floors

With our new advanced print technology you can apply layered effects such as gradients, 3D
illusions, shadows, and transparency directly on our portable sports floor systems. This is your
freedom to express your courts visual identity on a sports floor that meets the highest performance
standards. 

[PRINTED SPORTS FLOORS][201]

## PARTNER EXTENSION | Official Global FIBA Supplier
* **FIBA EuroBasket 2025**
* **FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup 2026**
* **FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027**
* **Olympic Basketball Tournaments Los Angeles 2028**

the exceptional quality of Junckers’ hardwood sports flooring but also highlights our reputation as
a trusted and dependable partner. It reflects the strong working relationship we have built with
FIBA and our commitment to delivering excellence in every aspect - from production and planning to
execution and quality control. - *Thomas Bendixen, CEO of Junckers

[Explore our partnership with FIBA][202]

Design your own room in our interactive showroom.

SPC PANEL

SPC Wall Panels are waterproof, moisture-proof, wear-resistant, fire-resistant, environmentally
friendly and formaldehyde-free, suitable for all kinds of indoor and outdoor environments. They are
easy to install, low maintenance cost, and provide a variety of design style options.

WPC WALL PANEL

WPC Wall Panels combine the natural beauty of wood and the durability of plastic. They are
waterproof, moisture-proof, anti-corrosive and insect-proof, and are suitable for indoor and outdoor
decoration. They are environmentally friendly, non-toxic, easy to maintain, and easy to install, and
can meet diverse design needs.

SPC FLOORING

SPC Flooring is highly durable, waterproof, and resistant to scratches, making it ideal for
high-traffic areas and wet environments. It’s also eco-friendly, free of formaldehyde, easy to
install, and available in a wide range of designs and textures.

WPC FLOORING

WPC Flooring combines the natural look of wood with the durability of plastic, offering a
waterproof, stable, and comfortable underfoot experience. It's low-maintenance, eco-friendly, and
ideal for both indoor and outdoor spaces, with various design options available.

SLAT WALL PANEL

SLAT Wall Panel can be matched with wall panels. It has the same thickness as the wall panels, and
the wall surface has better integrity. The formaldehyde content level is E0. It is waterproof and
moisture-proof, wear-resistant and scratch-resistant, and the fireproof level reaches B1.
