### what our happy customers says about us!

## Beautiful herringbone floors and expert workmanship

Northern Rivers Flooring Specialists did our floors about 18 months ago and we absolutely love them
every day! Once we settled on oak parquetry flooring laid in a herringbone pattern, it was a big
decision as to which tradesperson to trust with the demanding task of laying it well. We got a few
quotes but Harry impressed us right from the start. We are so glad we chose Northern Rivers Flooring
Specialists – they did an amazing job! Our floors look fantastic, they feel lovely barefoot, and
they are easy to keep clean. Having beautiful flooring throughout the whole house has improved every
single room drastically – it is one of my favourite parts of the renovation we did for sure! The
whole team at Northern Rivers Flooring Specialists were very professional, but also very relaxed and
super easy to deal with. Harry’s attention to detail and workmanship was very impressive. Would
recommend his services to anyone – thanks Harry!!

## Nat & Joe Stokes

## Wide range and expert installation

I recently used this flooring supply and installation service for my home renovation project, and I
couldn’t be happier with the outcome. The team provided a wide range of high-quality flooring
options and offered expert advice to help me make the best choice for my space. The installation
process was seamless, with the team displaying professionalism and attention to detail from start to
finish. The end result is stunning, transforming the look and feel of my home. I highly recommend
their services to anyone looking to enhance their space with beautiful, quality flooring.

## Rich Alsop

## Excellent communication and stunning finish

Many thanks Harry and Paul for an excellent job on our kitchen/dining room floor in Mullum! We
couldn’t be happier with the communication, friendly advice, great price and, perhaps most
importantly, the stunning finish of the end result! Excellent work Paul! We’re now getting Harry and
his team to do the floorboards in the rest of the house. I’d happily recommend Northern Rivers
Flooring 100%, without any hesitation whatsoever! Thanks guys! Floorboards throughout the house now
done. Excellent, excellent, excellent! So very happy with the results! Thanks Harry, Peter and Alan.
You guys are the best.

## Allan Mulroy

## Friendly professional and hands on service

Cannot recommend anyone better than Harry and Northern Rivers Flooring. Harry went above and beyond
to offer me the most hands-on service, ensuring that my bedroom renovation went smoothly and
efficiently. I really appreciated the way Harry took the time to clearly communicate the execution
of the project and his overall friendly demeanour. Despite having the ability to steer me down more
expensive paths, Harry worked with me to find flooring that best suited me and the project. I am
ecstatic about the way my floors from Havwoods turned out. I can’t wait to work with Northern Rivers
Flooring in the future.

## Barron Hilton

## Exceptional advice and premium customer care

We had an absolutely incredible experience with Northern Rivers Flooring Co, thanks to Harry! From
the very start, he provided outstanding advice and guidance, helping us choose the best flooring
options with a level of integrity and expertise that’s rare in the industry. His transparent,
no-nonsense approach made decision-making effortless, ensuring we ended up with flooring that
perfectly suited our needs both aesthetically and functionally. The quality is truly second to none.
The level of communication was nothing short of exceptional professional

Specialists – they did an amazing job! Our floors look fantastic, they feel lovely barefoot, and
they are easy to keep clean. Having beautiful flooring throughout the whole house has improved every
single room drastically – it is one of my favourite parts of the renovation we did for sure! The
whole team at Northern Rivers Flooring Specialists were very professional, but also very relaxed and
super easy to deal with. Harry’s attention to detail and workmanship was very impressive. Would
recommend his services to anyone – thanks Harry!!

## Premium Oak Parquet Flooring — Manufactured in Lithuania                                         
                                                                                                    
PerfektoWood is based in Lithuania. We have been offering premium hardwood flooring — solid and     
engineered oak parquet flooring — for over 20 years, supplying distributors, construction companies,
and interior designers across Europe.                                                               
                                                                                                    
## Our Oak Parquet Collections                                                                      
* [Solid Oak Herringbone Parquet][62] — classic zigzag pattern in multiple dimensions and 4 grading 
  options                                                                                           
* [Solid Oak Chevron Parquet][63] — 45° and 60° angle-cut boards forming a continuous V-shape       
* [Solid Oak Boards][64] — 16,22mm thickness, widths up to 180mm, lengths up to 2000mm              
* [Engineered Oak Parquet][65] — 2-layer construction for underfloor heating compatibility          
* [Industrial Oak Parquet][66] — 16×8×160mm solid oak for high-traffic commercial spaces            
* [Custom Hardwood Flooring Solutions][67] — aged, brushed, and bespoke finishes produced to project
  specifications                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
## Why Choose PerfektoWood?                                                                         
* Over 20 years of production experience                                                            
* European oak sourced responsibly                                                                  
* Custom dimensions available for B2B projects                                                      
* Awarded "Strongest in Lithuania" by Creditinfo — 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026                       
                                                                                                    
We supply flooring distributors, construction companies, architects, and interior designers across  
Europe — Germany, France, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.   
[Contact us][68] to request pricing, samples, or a wholesale catalogue.

A pioneer leading company specialized in Prefabricated Buildings, Steel Structure and Container
System by adopting the latest technologies.

subsidiary of **Aal Imran Group **which is serving the Qatari Market since **1981**.

***Smart House**** operates 4 major production lines as following:*
* Pre Engineered Steel Structures
* Pre-Fabricated Buildings (Light Gauge Steel known as LGS)
* Container System Solutions
* Joinery Works

# Architecture, Design, and Home Improvement

Professional guidance, expert info, helpful tools, and more.

[Brandon-Hubbard-00.jpg]

Hi there, welcome to my site! I am Brandon Hubbard.

As an industry professional, I share my advice and experience working as an architect. I have always
been interested in solving problems and finding ways to make tasks more efficient. As a result, I
developed a passion for finding the extraordinary features in ordinary products. This led to
providing comprehensive and informative content to help make your next project easier.

## Why choose Trivec?

“Creating solutions together” embodies our commitment to quality, innovation, and collaboration.
Trivec machines are not just products; they are tailored solutions designed to enhance efficiency
and make production processes more sustainable. Everything we do focuses on achieving the best
finishing of product surfaces and optimizing handling within production processes. What is your
challenge that we can help you with?

[Target Icon]
Strong
together

## Strong together

We believe in the power of collaboration. Together with clients, glue and lacquer manufacturers and
other partners and suppliers, we aim to find the best solution. Our team thinks along with you and
guides you from concept to installation, always with your goals in mind.

[Target Icon]
Client-
focused

## Client-focused

Your needs and challenges are at the centre of what we do. We deliver high-quality sustainable
solutions that meet your expectations and ensure efficient use of resources, materials and people.

[Target Icon]
Trusted

## Trusted

As a client, you can count on us and we act honestly and ethically. We do so proactively and with
prompt service. We are ready when you need us, with solutions that contribute directly to the
continuity of your business.

[Target Icon]
Sustainable
quality

## Sustainable quality

Trivec machines and machine lines are designed and manufactured with the greatest care and attention
to detail. Offering quality and sustainable solutions is in our DNA from initial design to
after-sales service. This guarantees machines that perform, are durable and provide a sustainable
working environment.

[Target Icon]
Innovation
and
customisation

## Innovation and customisation

We strive for continuous improvement and new solutions. We confert knowledge and experience into
innovative solutions and techniques that, where necessary, are custom designed and built. From
standard machines to fully customised solutions, in close cooperation with you and our partners.

[Target Icon]
Trivec
Experience
Center

## Trivec Experience Center

Trivec’s own test centre offers you a production setup that allows you to realise and experience
your current or future production process in full control. By testing and fine-tuning your own
application live, we find together, and in close cooperation with your paint or glue manufacturers,
the best solutions tailored perfectly to your specific challenge.

We specialise in providing machinery solutions for surface finishing and treatment for a variety of
industries. Explore how we support your branche or sector with our innovative approach and
expertise.

## Why choose Trivec?

“Creating solutions together” embodies our commitment to quality, innovation, and collaboration.
Trivec machines are not just products; they are tailored solutions designed to enhance efficiency
and make production processes more sustainable. Everything we do focuses on achieving the best
finishing of product surfaces and optimizing handling within production processes. What is your
challenge that we can help you with?

[Target Icon]
Strong
together

## Strong together

We believe in the power of collaboration. Together with clients, glue and lacquer manufacturers and
other partners and suppliers, we aim to find the best solution. Our team thinks along with you and
guides you from concept to installation, always with your goals in mind.

[Target Icon]
Client-
focused

## Client-focused

Your needs and challenges are at the centre of what we do. We deliver high-quality sustainable
solutions that meet your expectations and ensure efficient use of resources, materials and people.

[Target Icon]
Trusted

## Trusted

As a client, you can count on us and we act honestly and ethically. We do so proactively and with
prompt service. We are ready when you need us, with solutions that contribute directly to the
continuity of your business.

[Target Icon]
Sustainable
quality

## Sustainable quality

Trivec machines and machine lines are designed and manufactured with the greatest care and attention
to detail. Offering quality and sustainable solutions is in our DNA from initial design to
after-sales service. This guarantees machines that perform, are durable and provide a sustainable
working environment.

[Target Icon]
Innovation
and
customisation

## Innovation and customisation

We strive for continuous improvement and new solutions. We confert knowledge and experience into
innovative solutions and techniques that, where necessary, are custom designed and built. From
standard machines to fully customised solutions, in close cooperation with you and our partners.

[Target Icon]
Trivec
Experience
Center

## Trivec Experience Center

Trivec’s own test centre offers you a production setup that allows you to realise and experience
your current or future production process in full control. By testing and fine-tuning your own
application live, we find together, and in close cooperation with your paint or glue manufacturers,
the best solutions tailored perfectly to your specific challenge.

We specialise in providing machinery solutions for surface finishing and treatment for a variety of
industries. Explore how we support your branche or sector with our innovative approach and
expertise.

## Zimbo's Flooring & Decking Solutions

Zimbo’s Flooring & Decking Solutions was founded in 2002 by CEO David Waddy. Beginning as Zimbo’s
Trading, the company specialised in solid wooden flooring and decking, predominantly Zimbabwean
teak.

As demand grew, Zimbo’s expanded its range to include numerous timber species and both solid and
engineered flooring. Today Zimbo’s is one of the largest and most diverse importers of solid and
engineered flooring, maintaining normal stocks in excess of 20,000 m2, and has become a market
leader in supply and installation of flooring, specialist staircases, decking, and related trade and
retail products.

Zimbo’s Flooring Solutions is also the national distributor for [Loba][71], [Wakol][72] and [Janser
products][73] (which are manufactured in Germany), and partners with many other prestigious
international suppliers. Regular annual training and product workshops keep the team up to date with
the latest systems and installation techniques. The company is represented nationally with showrooms
in Cape Town, Gauteng and Durban – check Zimbo’s newsletter for updates.

**We pride ourselves on delivering quality, professional solutions for all wooden flooring and
decking needs.**

ABOUT

## Zimbo's Flooring & Decking Solutions

Zimbo’s Flooring & Decking Solutions was founded in 2002 by CEO David Waddy. Beginning as Zimbo’s
Trading, the company specialised in solid wooden flooring and decking, predominantly Zimbabwean
teak.

As demand grew, Zimbo’s expanded its range to include numerous timber species and both solid and
engineered flooring. Today Zimbo’s is one of the largest and most diverse importers of solid and
engineered flooring, maintaining normal stocks in excess of 20,000 m2, and has become a market
leader in supply and installation of flooring, specialist staircases, decking, and related trade and
retail products.

Zimbo’s Flooring Solutions is also the national distributor for [Loba][71], [Wakol][72] and [Janser
products][73] (which are manufactured in Germany), and partners with many other prestigious
international suppliers. Regular annual training and product workshops keep the team up to date with
the latest systems and installation techniques. The company is represented nationally with showrooms
in Cape Town, Gauteng and Durban – check Zimbo’s newsletter for updates.

**We pride ourselves on delivering quality, professional solutions for all wooden flooring and
decking needs.**
